correctness.rationale: For nonempty teams, equality throughout induces a partition of variables; marking classes that take a single constant value gives a realizable profile (c<=|M| for q>=2, special singleton q=1). Under uniform single-value quantification, a witness either equals one of c existing constant classes or is new; it cannot equal an unmarked nonconstant class throughout. The induction on formula structure gives correct truth for all profiles. There are at most 2L simultaneously active variables, so cardinalities q>=2L+2 give identical fresh-value branching; DFS enumerates profiles using polynomial space. QBF reduction uses an exact-two-elements weak-team sentence and maps quantified Boolean truth to equality with two distinguished constants; truth on the empty team does not supply satisfiability witnesses. Validity and equivalence hardness follow from a guarded sentence. Source checker sampled 18,830 cases and 400 QBF formulas; these tests are not substitutes for the induction.
